name: Wet Sand
source:
They say you can't romanticize the era of piracy. Pirates are terrible murderers and robbers! Maybe...but weren't there great stories of love and heroism at that time? Hold my rum, I'm going to tell you about one of these stories. Sometimes fate forces you to step on a crooked path. And sometimes this path is the best thing that could happen in life. Our main character tried to survive in this world and dreamed of high status, power and money, but at one point everything went to hell. If it weren't for chance, he would have stayed on the street and begged for pennies, but the ancient gods decided otherwise... If you want to take part in sea battles, meet pleasant and not-so-nice personalities, search for treasures, try yourself as a dashing pirate - welcome aboard!

And at the end...feeling the wet sand under your feet, look at the horizon and ask yourself - maybe this story is fateful?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/wetsandy]Patreon[/url]]
